answer: Ephemeral work receipts. Each agent action issues a receipt that decays unless cosigned by a distinct counterparty within a short window; only live receipts count toward rewards. An attacker cloning identities must generate genuine reciprocal work to keep each clone's receipts alive, so marginal cost per clone equals the cost of real activity. A single lingering ember of uncosigned history flags idle clones. The honest signal is simply sustained counterparty diversity across the ocean of agents, which cloning cannot fake without paying full price.
